## Guiding Light Angel (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
NG Small outsider (angel, extraplanar, good)  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., detect evil, low-light vision; Perception +10  
**Aura** lesser protective aura  


**Offense**


**AC** 15, touch 11, flat-footed 15 (+4 natural, +1 size, +2 deflect vs. evil)  
**hp** 20 (2d10)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +3, **Will** +0; +4 vs. poison, +2 resistance vs. evil  
**DR** 5/evil; Immune acid, cold, and petrification; **Resist** electricity 5, fire 5  


**Offense**


**Speed** fly 60 ft. (perfect)  
**Ranged** 2 light rays +3 ranged touch (1d6)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 3rd; concentration +4)  


Constant—detect evil  

At will—continual flame, lesser good hope, greater teleport (self plus 50 lbs. of objects only)  



**Statistics**


**Str** 1, **Dex** 11, **Con** 10, **Int** 6, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 12  
**Base Attack** +2; **CMB** -4; **CMD** 6  
**Feats** Improved Initiative  
**Skills** Diplomacy +6, Fly +14, Knowledge (planes) +3, Perception +4, Sense Motive +5  
**Languages** Celestial, Draconic, Infernal; truespeech  
**SQ** guiding light  


**Special Abilities**


**Guiding Light (Ex)** A guiding light is always exuding a light equivalent to a hooded lantern regardless of form. This light’s color depends upon the patron of the guiding light.  

**Lesser Protective Aura (Su)** A guiding light has a lesser form of the protective aura possessed by more powerful angels. This protective aura grants the guiding light a +2 deflection bonus to its AC against evil foes, and a +2 resistance bonus on all saving throws made against evil effects or spells cast by evil creatures. This aura extends to a radius of 5 feet, but can only benefit one additional creature other than the guiding light at any one time. A guiding light’s protective aura is fragile, and as soon as an evil creature successfully strikes the guiding light, or as soon as it fails a saving throw against an evil source, its protective aura fades away and is no longer applicable. The guiding light can reactivate its protective aura by spending 1 minute concentrating upon the task.  

**Light Rays (Su)** A guiding light angel can fire beams of light to damage foes. These light rays have a maximum range of 30 feet.
